Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff:

1) Business success criteria (from your side) — what we heard on the call:
   - Reduce human review for data extraction by 60% on the first pass (target F1 >= 0.78)
   - End-to-end latency < 400ms for single-document extraction (95th percentile)
   - Integration into their ingestion pipeline with streaming for high-volume batches

2) Proposed POC scope (technical):
   - 2-week trial running on Redwood hosted with streaming input and SDK routing
   - Evaluate model variants (r13-small -> r13-medium) and a quantized path for cost testing
   - Instrumentation: token-level latency + per-request quality sampling against the gold set

3) Owners / asks:
   - Optix dev lead to confirm a test dataset and a sandbox endpoint for streaming ingestion (Samira)
   - Redwood SE to provide SDK examples and a sample streaming-config.yaml (Aditya)
   - Redwood SRE/infra to propose concurrency and batching defaults (Neha)

4) Proposed timeline:
   - Kickoff call: Monday 2026-09-20
   - Sandbox ingestion + test data by 2026-09-22
   - Trial run: 09/23 - 09/30 (one week of steady-state evaluation)
   - Wrap & decision: 10/04

Attachments: optix_poc_scope_v1.pdf (POC scope doc)

Can you confirm the success criteria above and who from Optix will own the sandbox / ingestion work? If Monday works for kickoff I’ll schedule and add the SE/SRE dial-ins.
